confidence_note: Book text not read; wording from the authors' site, Wikipedia and an extension-service explainer (marked as not from the book). Old text's patient dialogue and the emotion-eat-guilt cycle are invented or unverified and omitted.
facts: The principle 'Cope with your emotions with kindness': restriction can itself trigger loss of control; address anxiety, loneliness, boredom or anger through other means since food only offers temporary relief.
The site's line: 'Food won't fix any of these feelings.'
Respect your body: accept your genetic body size and shape, like your shoe size; harsh criticism of your body makes it harder to reject diet mentality.

An extension-service explainer (not the book) suggests pausing with curiosity when the urge to snack comes under stress, perhaps journaling, and building a broader emotional toolbox if food is the only coping tool.
Reviews suggest the approach may reduce eating-disorder symptoms; results vary; people with certain conditions may be told by a doctor to follow a specific diet.
scene_details: the cupboard after a stressful moment
tension: Food gives only temporary relief from feelings, and restriction can itself trigger loss of control.
opening_idea: The site lists anxiety, loneliness, boredom and anger and says food won't fix any of them.

lessons.idea: Name the feeling before deciding about the food.
lessons.anchor: the principle's list of feelings food will not fix

reflect_final: Which feeling do you most often meet with a snack when your body has not asked for food?

use_cases.situation: At the cupboard after a tense phone call
use_cases.move: Say you are wound up, not hungry, and get water first.

use_cases.situation: A friend says they eat when lonely
use_cases.move: Ask what they would want in that moment if it weren't food.

use_cases.situation: Your teenager comes home upset and heads for the kitchen
use_cases.move: Offer a snack or a talk, either is fine.

pocket_idea: Food won't fix anxiety, loneliness, boredom or anger; name the feeling first, then decide about the snack.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: Food won't fix anxiety, loneliness, boredom or anger, the authors' site says.
conversation_variants.thirty_sec_idea: Cope with emotions with kindness, the list of feelings, respect your body, caveat.
